needs: A spell's choice between instruction lists asked as a labelled question; the AST carries no option labels, so `one_of` needs them from the card text or a generated label list.
A villainous choice (CR 701.55): each opponent in turn picks one of the options for the card to apply.

A change to one spell on the stack or to the next spell a player casts: counters it enters with, abilities and keywords it gains, its total cost, can't be countered, and changes that continue on the permanent it becomes.
Effects made at resolution on objects, players, each spell that matches including later ones, or the next matching spell, for a duration: discounts, abilities gained, plays allowed.
A rule of the game changed for a duration, made by a resolving effect: combat damage not assigned or prevented, phases skipped, permanents that phase, and the like.
Clash (CR 701.30): each clashing player reveals the top card of their library and may put it on the bottom; whether the actor won.
Voting (CR 701.38) on words, players, objects or graveyard cards, open or secret, that records votes for `g.votes()` to read; only `vote::for_permanents` exists and it records nothing.
Stickers (Unfinity): a player's sticker sheet, putting a chosen or named sticker on an object, and the ticket cost. A casual-only mechanic.
Intensity (CR 702.169): a value kept on cards that follows them through zones and is raised for each matching card a player owns. Digital-only.
Abandoning an ongoing scheme (Archenemy, CR 314.5): the scheme card leaves the game's ongoing state. A casual variant.
Secret choices and votes kept hidden until a later instruction makes them known.
Things one player does to another: heist (Alchemy, digital-only), controlling a player's next turn or combat, and exchanging life totals with them.
The exchanges past life totals and control of two permanents: ownership, text boxes, power, life with power or toughness, zones, ante, control of a set with a player, and any until a duration ends.
api: cantrip_mechanics::exchange::exchange(g, source, Exchange::.., first, second, until)

needs: Copying or retargeting a spell or ability with the new targets stated: each legal target, to a set, at random; `copy_spell` and the change-target calls only ask the player or keep them.
api: cantrip_mechanics::copy::{on_stack, on_stack_each, retarget, retarget_each}(g, player, .., NewTargets::..)?

needs: A value remembered on an object for a later read: a number, a player, a life total, counters, mana spent, an ordering of cards.
Damage from one instruction that can't be prevented (CR 615.12), a rider of that damage alone rather than a rule for the turn as `damage_cant_be_prevented` is.
Damage with a rider: excess to a player, part of it prevented, or divided by a player other than the controller.
A choice between power/toughness adjustments, with a read of each half of what was chosen.
A guess of a hidden card's quality or a player's secret choice, with a read of whether it was right.
api: cantrip_mechanics::guess::guess(g, player, source, object, filter, of)?

needs: Bidding (Forge's Bid): players raise a stake in turn until all pass, and the winning amount and player are read. Casual cards.
Seek (Alchemy, digital-only): a card chosen at random from those that match is put into hand from the library.
Looking at a player's hand and taking a card of it to do something: they play it, it goes on top, it is cast free, it is discarded.
api: cantrip_mechanics::hand::pick_from_hand(g, actor, player, source, filter, count, HandPick::..)?

needs: Life totals redistributed among players (Reverse the Sands): each gets one of the totals, chosen in turn.
A player's speed lowered with a floor; only `increase_speed` exists.
A limit on the X announced for a spell or ability, read by a rule of the announcement.
The game restarts with some cards left out (Karn Liberated), then an action happens in the new game.
Moved objects return when a duration ends, in one effect with the move (CR 610.3), for durations past the permanent leaving play.
A permanent turned face down as a stated creature, with the characteristics the AST gives.
Several different instructions as one event (CR 608.2): the generated code runs them in order, and a batch of unlike actions is what is missing. The hole stands beside the real code.
api: planned!("operation-together", Together) beside the instructions, then g.one_instruction(|g| ..)

needs: Changes to combat by a resolving effect: reassign what attacks or blocks, make a blocker block, swap blocks, only these attack or block.
An action offered to a set of players, any one or each, optionally and once each turn, with what follows when no one did.
Casting or playing on terms the cast call has no field for: a spend-as rule, a limit, a window, effects the spell gets, a group rule over what is cast together.
api: cantrip_mechanics::play::with_terms(g, player, source, CardPlay::.., cards, count, group, terms)?

needs: A reflexive trigger on what came of an action: a regeneration that happened, excess damage, a revealed quality.
A boon (Alchemy, digital-only): a trigger on the player, used up after a number of uses.
api: cantrip_mechanics::boon::create(g, source, player, times, event, condition, body)

needs: A delayed trigger that a player can stop by paying when it fires.
Any number of named piles, kept across instructions, with one chosen by a player or at random; `choose::separate` and `pile` do two piles at once.
Populate (CR 701.36) with the entry the token gets; no call for it exists.
One payment offered to each of a set of players in turn, with what follows if none paid or one did.
A cost that is not only mana paid any number of times, by one or each player, or once for each chosen object; `may_pay_times` takes mana alone.
One step for each kind of counter among objects (as Forge's AddOrRemoveCounter).
api: cantrip_mechanics::counters::each_kind(g, player, source, among, options, optional)?

needs: A counter of a chosen kind for each object: one of several, a random missing one, one per color, or one keyword counter per ability.
Phases and steps past a plain combat: combat and main together, upkeep, beginning, end, with what happens as the added phase starts.
A spell countered to a stated place, gated on what it is; `counter_to` covers the fixed places.
Control given to a set of players at once, or to a player the effect doesn't otherwise name.
Attaching chosen objects to several hosts or to a player; `attach` takes one object and one object host.
Flipping that a player may stop or that another player calls.
api: cantrip_mechanics::coins::flips(g, player, times, until_lost, may_stop, called)?

needs: One target slot across modes, the target chosen deciding the mode (CR 601.2c): 'target spell or permanent' is no announced mode.
A mode not chosen during a player's last combat: `history` reads this turn and ever, and no record of the last combat exists.
No two chosen modes may share a target.
A player other than the controller chooses the modes (CR 700.2c).
Modes the game picks at random.
A pawprint budget (CR 700.2i): modes have weights and their total is limited.
A target slot chosen by a player other than the controller (CR 601.2c, 603.3d).
A target the game picks at random among legal targets.
A set rule that assigns each target to its own filter, by a bipartite matching.
A slot's size read as it is chosen; a TargetSpec's bounds are constants or the X announced.
A prevention shield that prevents all of the next damage event ('the next time a source would deal damage'), and goes; `Shield` has All and Next(n) only.
A prevention shield with a limit for each recipient rather than in total.

match: ^reflexive ability about a list of objects$
needs: A reflexive ability that carries a list of objects; `reflexive_trigger` carries one subject and `delayed_trigger_about` is for delayed triggers alone.
api: g.reflexive_trigger_about(source, controller, ability, &objects), read with about(q, item, part)

match: ^reflexive ability about (two objects|an object and a player)$|^delayed ability about
needs: A delayed or reflexive ability that carries more than one subject, of mixed kinds.

An object put onto the battlefield in a stated state past the transformed, face-down, attached and attacking calls: as a copy, blocking, flipped, prepared, attached to one chosen as it enters, with changes that last a duration or that apply only to what matches.
api: cantrip_mechanics::enter::in_state(g, o, controller, item, states, &[counters], tapped)?

needs: A move with entry flags for a zone that has no entry: one exile pile, shuffled so no one can tell which card is which.
A value chosen on terms: secretly, not what was chosen before, at random, in order, up to a number, with exceptions; the answer asked of each of several players.
More than one value of a kind chosen at once, read back as a set: `chosen_*` holds one.
A value chosen by a resolving ability, or for a hidden agenda, and read by another ability or a later turn: the engine keeps only the choices made as a permanent entered.

match: ^a choice of (CardType|PermanentType|Filter|Recipient|ColorOrColorless|PlaneswalkerType|NonbasicLandType|Letter|ColorAndCreatureType|Direction|LandType|Parity|Ability|Number)( kept on a permanent)?$
needs: A question for this kind of value: `RequestKind` asks for colors, a name, a subtype of a listed set, a number and a player, and has no word for a card type, a direction, a letter or a filter, and `labels` hold no generated list of these options.
api: RequestKind::ChooseCardType and the like; a held value on `Entering`

needs: One search episode (CR 701.23h) with several find clauses, each with its own rule: `library::search` takes one `Selection` and each call is a search.
A rule of found cards `select` has no part for: named after one of each of a set, one for each filter, at random, a common property.
A rule of chosen cards `select` has no part for: no common color pair, total with a read amount, a distinct count.
A rule of targets `select` has no part for, or that needs a part read as chosen: limits shared with another slot, no common property.

match: ^target count by branch |^targeted by |^target object domain |^target reference past a slot of no fixed size$|^target reference to no earlier slot$
needs: Target slots whose size depends on the branch of a cost, target rules that read which ability targets, and reads past a slot of no fixed size: `chosen_targets` holds a flat list.
A trigger or replacement made by a resolving ability reads the targets of the ability that made it (603.7c): a created effect has no closure over them. A few are a cost change that reads targets.
api: g.created_about(&targets), read with about(q, item, part)

match: ^delayed trigger (on event|at|starting|until|on turns of|outside a resolving ability)
needs: `DelayedWhen` for events and times it has no variant for, and delayed triggers made by a static or replacement that has no stack item: an object or player event, main phase begins, an extra turn, a stated player's next turn, one that lapses at end of turn.
api: DelayedWhen::{OnEvent(matcher), MainPhase, Turn(player), ..} and g.delayed_trigger from a static's Asker

match: ^reflexive trigger outside a resolving ability$|^reflexive trigger with no base action$
needs: A reflexive trigger made where no stack item resolves: inside a replacement or a cost.

An effect that removes one named ability or kind of ability from an object (CR 613.1f): `EffectKind` removes all abilities, or a set of keywords, and not this ability, enchant, a chosen ability, hexproof kinds or landwalk.
Planechase (CR 901): a planar deck, chaos, planeswalking. A casual variant.
Several dice rolled as one roll, kept highest or in order, or stored for later (CR 706): `roll_die` rolls one.
A keyword action with no call, or with an amount the call does not take: stakes, attractions, time travel, sectors, a chosen copy, a mana ability activated by an effect.
A cost a `Cost` can't hold: an action by a player, mana with a bound X, a choice revealed, a part that targets, or an exile of a stated object.
A stated number of modes or none.
Cards moved on a group rule, a chosen count from a set, or a random order, past the search and choice calls: 'any number with total X or less', and the entry they get.
api: cantrip_mechanics::choose::select with the group's `Part` then a move; cantrip_mechanics::enter::in_state

needs: A search of the top cards, or of other zones with an 'and/or', or of cards outside the game, as one episode.
Exile face down in a pile, and a move to a hand by a stated owner.
api: g.exile_face_down(&cards, by) with a pile; g.move_to(card, Zone::hand(player))

needs: Revealing until the revealed cards satisfy a rule of the group, or a count with a limit.
An action for each number in a range; a chosen defender; a random pick of an ability, color or action; counters moved or put with an amount each player sets.

match: ^objects that paid a cost at resolution$
needs: `may_pay` of a cost with several parts or a choice inside it to report which objects paid: 'you may pay {1}{R} and discard a card. If you do, deals damage equal to the discarded card's mana value'.

match: ^target of a reflexive ability reading what its ability did$
needs: A target rule of a reflexive ability that reads a value of the ability that made it (an object, a player, a number past the one count): a target filter is given no stack item, and the engine tells a reflexive ability one count, read only as `TargetSpec::COUNTED`.
api: the reflexive ability's target filter reading q.reflexive_subject(asker), or a value passed to g.reflexive_trigger_about

match: ^amount of an event its trigger does not carry$
needs: The total of the events an ability answers ('one or more ... that much', 'that many'), or the number of an event that reports none: `event_objects` gives the objects of a batch and no amounts.
Counters a player has read by kind and put by kind, as `counter_array` and `add_counters` do for an object: poison, energy, experience, rad and the rest behind one call.
A direction, left or right, chosen and kept, for an order of players (CR 101.4 for a multiplayer game): no word for it in `RequestKind`.
api: RequestKind::ChooseDirection, with the walk starting there

needs: What each player does as one batch of events when a choice falls between (CR 101.4, 603.2c): `instruction` holds one batch only without a suspension, so where the steps can't be gathered into one call each player's turn is its own batch.
api: g.begin_batch()/g.end_batch() around the walk, with the walk's code as it stands

match: ^cost objects outside a resolving ability$|^cost objects of Branch$
needs: What paid a cost, read where no stack item is: a mana ability ('add an amount of {B} equal to the sacrificed creature's mana value'), a target rule or a choice of branch of a cost. A mana ability's function is given no record of what paid.
api: q.paid_for(asker), given to a mana ability's function
